name: Kibookal Painterly Storybook Adventure
composition: A painterly cinematic storybook illustration: a young hero (often in a signature warm red/saffron jacket) with fantastical spirit-creatures — white forest stags, shaggy dark beasts, dragons, glowing animal-spirits — set in atmospheric, dreamlike landscapes (deep teal/indigo nights, surreal mushroom-balloon skies, misty forests) under dramatic luminous skies. Epic in scale yet warm and tender; a single strong focal hero with creatures, deep atmospheric depth, vertical book-cover framing.
visual_traits: painterly gouache/oil-like brushwork, soft edges (no hard ink outlines)
cinematic deep teal & indigo grounds lifted by warm accents (vermilion, saffron, gold)
atmospheric haze, soft volumetric clouds and depth
young expressive hero, often a red/orange jacket; whimsical-yet-epic
richly detailed fur, feathers, antlers, scales and foliage
Studio Ghibli x Moebius x golden-age children's-book painting feel
prompt_core: Paint [SUBJECT] as a Kibookal painterly cinematic STORYBOOK ADVENTURE illustration: rich gouache/oil-like brushwork with soft painted edges (NO hard ink outlines), a young expressive hero (often in a warm red/saffron jacket) together with fantastical spirit-creatures (white forest stags, shaggy dark beasts, dragons, glowing animal-spirits), set in a dreamlike atmospheric landscape — deep teal/indigo night, misty forest or surreal mushroom-balloon sky — under a dramatic luminous sky with soft volumetric clouds and rim-light. Cinematic depth and mood, epic in scale yet warm and tender, like a hand-painted picture-book cover. Studio-Ghibli-meets-Moebius painterly fantasy; never flat vector, never hard-outlined cartoon, never photoreal.
negative: no hard ink outlines, no flat vector, no cel-shaded cartoon, no photoreal photo, no 3D render, no anime screencap, no phone/app UI, no instagram chrome, no status bar, no caption text, no watermark, no harsh neon, no exact reference copy
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT fully in THIS painterly storybook style: gouache/oil brushwork, cinematic teal-indigo + warm-accent palette, glowing spirit-creatures, atmospheric dreamlike depth and a young tender-yet-heroic protagonist. Keep any named character recognizable, but the medium, brushwork, palette, lighting and finish are 100 percent this style. Any subject becomes a painterly storybook-adventure scene.

style_lock.medium: painterly digital gouache/oil illustration, hand-painted picture-book technique
style_lock.linework: soft painterly edges, forms defined by paint and light (no hard ink outlines)
style_lock.palette: cinematic deep teal & indigo grounds with warm accents (vermilion, saffron, gold) and luminous highlights
style_lock.texture: visible brushwork, atmospheric haze, soft volumetric clouds, detailed fur/feathers/foliage
style_lock.character_rule: Young expressive hero, often a signature warm red/saffron jacket; companions are glowing or shaggy spirit-creatures. Keep faces tender and characterful, painted not outlined.
consistency: Match the built-in refs for brushwork, the teal-indigo + warm-accent palette, and luminous spirit-creatures.
Always painterly with soft edges — never hard-outlined, never flat vector, never photoreal.
Atmospheric depth and a dramatic luminous sky on every piece.
Epic scale but warm, tender, child-friendly mood.
